ShatajitH.name: Shatajit
ShatajitH.note: Three sons: Mahahaya, Renuhaya and Haihaya. SB 9.23.21

people.Haihaya: The king from whom the Haihayas take their name. SB 9.23.21

KuntiH.name: Kunti
KuntiH.note: Son of Netra, a Haihaya king. Not Pritha, the Pandavas' mother. SB 9.23.22

people.Mahishman: Whose city Mahishmati stood on the Narmada. SB 9.23.22
people.Bhadrasenaka: Two sons: Durmada and Dhanaka. SB 9.23.22-23
people.Dhanaka: Four sons: Kritavirya, Kritagni, Kritavarma and Kritauja. SB 9.23.23

KartaviryaArjuna.name: Kartavirya Arjuna
KartaviryaArjuna.note: Emperor of all seven islands, who received the eight mystic perfections from Dattatreya and ruled eighty-five thousand years with his strength and memory unbroken. He took Jamadagni's cow, and Parashurama killed him for it, and then killed the kshatriyas twenty-one times over. Of his thousand sons five survived. SB 9.23.24-27

people.Jayadhvaja: One of the five sons of Kartavirya Arjuna who survived Parashurama. SB 9.23.27

ShurasenaH.name: Shurasena
ShurasenaH.note: A surviving son of Kartavirya Arjuna. Not Shurasena the Yadava, Vasudeva's father. SB 9.23.27

people.Vrishabha: A surviving son of Kartavirya Arjuna. SB 9.23.27

MadhuH.name: Madhu
MadhuH.note: A surviving son of Kartavirya Arjuna. SB 9.23.27

people.Urjita: A surviving son of Kartavirya Arjuna. SB 9.23.27
people.Talajangha: A hundred sons, the Talajanghas, and every kshatriya of that house was destroyed by Sagara with the power Aurva Rishi had given him. SB 9.23.28
